naming._comment: 40 characters accommodates 25 of the 43 existing labels while staying well below the 61-character maximum; new labels can be shorter because mechanisms and purpose belong in metadata. Grandfathered names preserve existing build directories and historical logs; do not add new names to this list.

base.description: Use all registry defaults as the untuned configuration reference for build and solver checks.

base_iosprecom_mona.description: Replace only input/output precomputation with MONA BDD traversal to isolate its effect in local tuning.

best.description: Retain the undecomposed powerset-precomputation experiment with standard automaton preprocessing, critical input selection and SIMD maximum comparisons disabled for historical logs.

best_mona.description: Use MONA precomputation, standard automaton preprocessing, critical input selection and no SIMD maximum comparisons without decomposition to measure the effect of decomposing specifications.

best_decomp_mona.description: Use plain vector-backed downsets with decomposition, MONA precomputation, standard automaton preprocessing, critical input selection and no SIMD maximum comparisons as the downset comparison reference.

best_decomp_mona_noequivariant.description: Disable the exact equivariant solver as the classic-only control for measuring symmetry solving with plain vector-backed downsets.

best_decomp_mona_any.description: Use Spot translation preference any instead of small to provide a shipped alternative translation with plain vector-backed downsets.

best_decomp_mona_race.description: Race Spot small and any translations to compare translation diversity against the plain-vector small-only reference.

best_decomp_kdtree_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with a k-d tree to compare spatial indexing in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_bboxtree_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with a bounding-box tree to compare dominance-query pruning in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_bboxtree_mona_noequivariant.description: Disable the exact equivariant solver as the classic-only control for measuring symmetry solving with bounding-box-tree downsets.

best_decomp_comptrie_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with a compressed trie to compare compressed storage in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_sharingtrie_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with a sharing trie to compare shared storage in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_simpsharingtree_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with the simple sharing-tree implementation to compare tree storage in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_sharingtree_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with the sharing-tree implementation to compare shared tree storage in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_mona_diag.description: Compile phase diagnostics, enabled at runtime by ACACIA_DIAG, to profile the plain-vector downset reference.

best_decomp_skiplist_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with a skip list to compare ordered indexing in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_cst_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with a covering sharing tree to compare covering-based storage in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with rank-bucketed vectors to compare rank-based dominance filtering in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_diag.description: Compile phase diagnostics, enabled at runtime by ACACIA_DIAG, to profile rank-bucketed downsets and MONA action construction.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_semantic_mona_.description: Enable the bounded local winning-certificate and root-refutation probe as the S reference for comparison with the backward B configuration.
Compile phase diagnostics, enabled at runtime by ACACIA_DIAG, to inspect the local-certificate reference.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_diag_eq_r.description: Lower equivariant recognition to two clients and raise its state cap to 32768, retaining the two-block gate, to diagnose symmetry excluded by admission thresholds.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_semantic_mona.description: Deduplicate equivalent MONA output actions before decoding to reduce action construction in the shipped backward solver with rank-bucketed downsets (B reference).

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_semantic_mona_.description: Retain geometric K-bound raising in the backward solver to resolve historical comparisons with the linear schedule.
Retain the forced-output contradiction check in the backward decision-only syntactic bypass for historical ablation logs.
Retain per-input pruning of globally dominated decoded semantic actions for historical action-reduction experiments.
Compile phase diagnostics, enabled at runtime by ACACIA_DIAG, to profile semantic action deduplication in the backward B reference.
Use on-the-fly forward safety solving and disable the exact equivariant path, with the local probe still off, as the F reference for backward-versus-forward comparisons.
Retain conditional downward covering of optimistic forward successors for historical covering-ablation logs.
Retain geometric K-bound raising in the forward solver to resolve historical comparisons with the linear schedule.
Compile phase diagnostics, enabled at runtime by ACACIA_DIAG, to profile the forward F reference.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_race.description: Race Spot small and any translations to compare translation diversity against the rank-bucketed small-only configuration.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_noequivar.description: Disable the exact equivariant solver as the classic-only control for measuring symmetry solving with rank-bucketed downsets.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_eq_baseli.description: Raise the equivariant block gate from two to four, keeping three clients and a 512-state cap, as the control for the client, block and state threshold sweep.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_eq_min_cl.description: Admit two-client symmetries with a four-block gate and 512-state cap to isolate the client threshold against the equivariant sweep control.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_eq_max_st.description: Raise the equivariant state cap to 2048 with three clients and four blocks to isolate the state threshold against the equivariant sweep control.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_mona_eq_min_bl.description: Use the parent's unchanged two-block gate, three clients and 512-state cap as the lower-block arm against the four-block equivariant sweep control.

best_decomp_filtered_vector_mona.description: Replace plain vector-backed downsets with coordinate-filtered vectors to compare dominance-candidate filtering in the downset sweep.

best_decomp_filtered_vector_mona_noequiv.description: Disable the exact equivariant solver as the classic-only control for measuring symmetry solving with filtered-vector downsets.

best_decomp_rank_bucketed_semantic_mona_.description: Retain the forced-output contradiction check in the forward decision-only syntactic bypass for historical ablation logs.

best_four_arm_contradiction.description: Ship backward and forward realizability arms plus formula and automaton forward unrealizability arms, re-enabling exact equivariant solving and adding forced-output contradiction checks to the F reference.

best_four_arm_bboxtree.description: Add semantic action deduplication and forward solving to bounding-box-tree downsets, shipping backward and forward realizability arms plus formula and automaton forward unrealizability arms.

ltlsynt_no_specials.description: ltlsynt with decomposition, bypass, and obligation synthesis disabled
